description: Repo-scale (axum-bookclub): archiving a club must cascade across list, member-creation, and book-creation call sites
prompts: Clubs gain an `archived` field (default false on creation). Add `POST /api/clubs/:club_id/archive`, which sets it to true. Archiving must cascade across THREE places: (1) `GET /api/clubs` excludes archived clubs by default, but includes them with `?include_archived=true`; (2) `POST /api/clubs/:club_id/members` must reject (400) adding a new member to an archived club; (3) `POST /api/clubs/:club_id/books` must ALSO reject (400) adding a new book to an archived club - both creation endpoints under an archived club must be blocked, not just one of them.

reference_solution.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "axum_bookclub"
version = "0.5.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "axum_bookclub"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "axum_bookclub"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }
http-body-util = "0.1"
